paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Accuracy of Llama3.3 on PopQA with respect to s_pop and o_pop

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between s_pop frequency and accuracy, comparing two different data trends. The x-axis is labeled "s_pop frequency (x10^4)", with a linear scale ranging from 1 to 19, marked at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy", also using a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The first data line is blue, using hexagonal-shaped markers and a dashed line style. It starts at approximately 0.7 accuracy at x equals 1, shows an increase, and maintains values around 0.9 between x equals 3 and 19, exhibiting a slight peak at x=9 before stabilizing at an Accuracy of 1. The second line is green, with square markers and a solid line style. It begins slightly less than 0.4 accuracy at x equals 1, shows fluctuations with a peak reaching approximately 1 at x = 17, and ends at a similar value by x = 19. Both lines include error bars, indicating variability at each data point. The blue line has lower variability for most of the points in comparison to the green line. Both lines intersect at around 1.0 at x=17. There is no legend attached to the plot to infer these lines.
